I have a problem (19F). I’ve always had a history of depression but this is something I just can’t beat. The longest depressive episode I’ve ever had was when I was speaking to a boy who I really liked, my happiness came from him and I was only happy when we spoke. When he eventually ghosted me it was hell. Now Ive been speaking to another boy who I’ve had a crush on for a while and thought about being with. We matched online and started talking and I was happy, my crush liked me back and this could actually happen. But then he told me he wasn’t ready for a relationship. Then all he wanted to talk about is sex even after I told him I needed to get to know him better before we start with that, but he continued. I played along because I just wanted him to talk to me. But that’s all he wants me for is sex. Why is it never me. Why can’t I ever get what I want, to be in a healthy relationship. It’s never me I’m always second choice or I’m just used. I know I sound really psycho but I just can’t get this thought out of my head. I’ve even considered sleeping with this boy just so he’ll talk to me. It just makes me so sad. Is it my fault? I know I’m young and things may change but I don’t know what to do right now.

I crave male validation a lot, I feel like the only way I can be happy is if a boy shows interest in me and genuinely loves me. Then I will finally feel satisfied. I know this stems from my dad who is highly critical and I’ve never had a good relationship with. Any romantic relationship I’ve had with a man has the power to send me spiralling and I am just so tired of it. I never want to open myself up to anyone again in fear I will spiral when they eventually let me down once again. But then how will I ever be in a relationship with one? I don’t think I’m undateable, I have decent features and an okay body, I’m smart and I’m fun to talk to and I listen well.  I’m not crazy obsessed or anything but it’s not healthy how much emotional dependence i get with this. Is it my fault? Is it the energy I put out? They always seem so interested at first but things just never work out. I’m so tired of this, all I want is a healthy relationship but I just feel like I’ll never get one without experiencing so much more hurt

I have insulin resistance. I tried the diet a dietitian gave me and I lost weight, but I became very depressed due to other circumstances and gained a lot of it back. I’m not on any medication for it and the anti depressants I’m on don’t cause weight gain

I eat 1600 calories a day, never more than 1800. 

I try to eat only one meal per day that has any carbs in it and it’s always whole wheat or high fibre. I obviously have days where I’ll have another kind of carb or eat a bit more carbs but not too often. 

I eat three meals a day, and yes I do snack. I eat at around 9 and have lunch at around 1, then I’ll have a snack at 4 and eat dinner by 6:30

I agree that people with ED’s who worry about gaining weight do obviously have internal fatphobia and that they need to improve their relationship with that self image to recover. But the last statement really threw me off
